transcript.text: Ronaldinho receives it wide on the left, one defender in front of him.
He shapes to go inside onto his stronger foot...
Oh! The elastico! Outside to inside in one motion — sensational!
He's past two of them now, driving toward the edge of the box.
Ronaldinho shapes to strike... and gets the effort away!
The crowd rises — that flip-flap was pure Ronaldinho, nobody else does it like that.

events.title: Isolated 1v1 wide
events.analysis: Ball to the left touchline isolates Ronaldinho against a single defender. Ideal elastico territory: the move needs exactly one committed opponent, not two.

events.title: Inside-shaping feint
events.analysis: He opens his hips as if cutting inside. This is the sell — the defender shifts weight to block the inside lane, which is precisely what the elastico punishes.

events.title: Elastico — the snap
events.analysis: One continuous touch: outside of the boot pushes the ball across, then the same foot whips it back inside — all in a single whip motion. Both CV sources and the player prior converge here; this is the highest-confidence event of the clip.

events.title: Beating the second man
events.analysis: The recovering defender arrives off-balance from the snap. Ronaldinho uses his forearm and hip to shield — legal, and brutally effective at full speed.

events.title: Strike on the run
events.analysis: Shot taken while decelerating from the dribble. Coaching note: the elastico only becomes a goal threat because the snap ends with the ball on his shooting foot, not under his body.
